utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m helping spread the word on the repair drive, but I’m only sharing what’s confirmed so far: it’ll cover small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn—just be careful with that list, since I’ve only confirmed small appliances and tools so far. I’m checking on the rest before we broaden the wording.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, Dane—I’ll tighten my wording to small appliances and tools for now, and I won’t mention the rest until you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Nell. For the repair drive, I’ve got next Saturday at Sam’s garage, with small appliances and tools first, then we’ll list supplies and match volunteers to each repair.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Morning, Eli—thanks, that helps me get caught up. I don’t have special repair skills, but I can help list supplies, label things, or point folks to Rosa and Jules.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s just the kind of help we need, Nell—please take the supply list and labeling table next Saturday, and we’ll send trickier questions over to Rosa and Jules.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Kira, I heard Sam’s aiming for next Saturday at his garage, but I’m still trying to nail down the start time around pickup and drop-off—are you free for any part of it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I might be, but can we confirm the date, exact drop-off window, and whether Sam’s garage is definitely the storage spot before I commit?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s fair — I’ve only got next Saturday at Sam’s garage confirmed so far, so I’ll check with Sam on the exact drop-off window and whether he’s definitely storing everything there before I put you down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Cleo, I’m still catching up—I only know the time and bring-list weren’t settled yet, and I promised Hana I’d check the date, location, urgent repairs, and who can help before saying anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah—that helps. If you can confirm the date, location, urgent repairs, and helpers, I’ll keep the supply list provisional until we know what’s actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds right, Cleo—keep it provisional for now, and I’ll ask around today so I don’t pass along half-baked details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad we’re moving on the repair drive, Vik, but I’d rather wait to announce it until Sam confirms the hours, storage plan, and volunteer slots.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That makes sense, Pia—I’ll hold off on announcing it and just keep telling folks the rough plan is collections first, with hours and storage still pending Sam’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik—that helps. Once Sam confirms those pieces, I’ll feel a lot better about sharing something clear instead of scrambling later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Hana, I’m glad I bumped into you — the repair drive is happening, but I’m still checking the noticeboard for the confirmed time before I spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — please don’t spread it until the time’s confirmed, and can you also check whether the focus is still roof leaks and front steps or small appliances and tools?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Hana — I’ll hold off until I’ve checked the noticeboard, and I’ll confirm whether it’s roof leaks and front steps or small appliances and tools before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, are you bringing people for the roof crew or the steps crew, and can you be there by 8:30?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Mina, I’m afraid I may have mixed that up—I’m bringing my spare hammer and screwdrivers to Opal for the tool collection, not a crew. I can try to be there by 8:30 if someone reminds me where to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bring the hammer and screwdrivers straight to the repair drive at 8:30, not Opal, and check in with Cleo at the supply table. Can you manage that without a reminder?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, I’m a little swamped and only skimmed the repair drive notes, but I remember you offered tools—are you still good to bring them Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think that was Gus offering the tools, not me — he’s bringing the screwdrivers, pliers, drill, fasteners, tape, and clamps, and coming early. I’m still confirming the Saturday details before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, thanks for catching that—told you I only skimmed it. I’ll point tool questions to Gus for now and wait on you for the confirmed Saturday details before I tell folks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Jules, I’ve got the repair drive marked for Saturday in the community room, and today I’m tracking tool drop-offs—what location or item should I note for you?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal—please note me for the community room, and I’ll bring a basic hand-tool kit plus a roll of masking tape for labeling items.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Jules—I’ll mark you for the community room with a basic hand-tool kit and one roll of masking tape for labeling.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa, we’re prioritizing safety repairs first—leaky roofs, broken steps, and heating issues. I’m still confirming the date, drop-off times, and storage before we announce more.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — let’s anchor the announcement around Sunday at the community center, with safety repairs first, and I’ll wait on your confirmed drop-off times and storage details before I share it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Hold the announcement for now—I’ll send the confirmed drop-off times and storage plan as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be by the labeled boxes sorting parts, Rey. I’m keeping quiet today, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli. I’ll steer any loose bits or clamps your way, and if you hear where sign-ups are landing, let me know quietly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know softly if I hear where they settle the sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I’m catching updates while I’m out—have you heard anything confirmed about safety repairs or who’s covering late-morning triage?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ira, I’ve only got my tools and early setup confirmed so far—I haven’t heard who’s on late-morning triage, but I can ask around when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—that still helps. If you hear who’s taking late-morning triage or any confirmed safety-repair priorities, please pass it my way and I’ll keep sharing updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I’m bringing my toolboxes, drill, fasteners, tape, clamps, and extension cords for the repair drive, and I’ll come early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s great, Gus—I’ll pass along that you’re bringing the toolboxes, drill, fasteners, tape, clamps, and extension cords, and that you’ll come early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Vik—just holler if you hear we’re short on anything else, and I’ll see what I can dig out of the garage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Hana, I’m quietly checking for leaky roofs, broken steps, or heating trouble before folks promise too much—have you heard of anyone who should be on that short list?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that matches my concern, but I don’t have confirmed names yet. Can we treat roof leaks, broken steps, and heating trouble as the short-list criteria for now, and only share names once we’ve checked with each household?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, that feels right—just the criteria for now, and I’ll only bring names back after each household says it’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mara, I’m still confirming the date, drop-off times, and storage before we announce more; priority is urgent safety-related home repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo—that sounds right; let’s hold off on broader announcements until those details are firm. I’ll note that safety-related repairs are the priority and check in with Gus once setup timing is clear.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. I’ll confirm the logistics first, then send you and Gus the setup timing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane — the repair drive is set for next Saturday at my garage, and we’re focusing on lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture fixes. I’m sorting tools and making the sign-up sheet now, so let me know if you want to help or bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — I’ll help spread that plainly: next Saturday at your garage, lamps, small appliances, and simple furniture fixes, with supplies listed as they come in. I can also check in with Uli about sorting parts or carrying things since they offered quiet help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Dane — thanks for keeping the message clear. If Uli’s up for it, quiet help sorting parts or carrying things would be really useful on the day.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira! I’m still helping pull the pieces together, but the main need right now is handy fixers and someone organized to help triage items late morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Jules — can you confirm whether “late morning” means a specific time, and who’s officially coordinating the triage table before I pass that along?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have a specific time or official triage lead confirmed yet, so I’d say late morning is still tentative. I’ll check back with Mara before you pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, I’m still fuzzy on the final setup—last I heard, drop-off’s by the community room entrance and tools are inside near the back wall, but please keep it marked as tentative.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—I’ll mark drop-off by the community room entrance and the tool station inside near the back wall as tentative until we get confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—if Jules confirms anything different, I’ll try to flag it, but for now that tentative note is the safest bet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Nell, good, I was hoping to catch you — the repair drive is definitely happening, but I’m checking the noticeboard for the confirmed time before I spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ve only heard that Jules is matching up handy folks and Gus is bringing tools early, so once you confirm the time I can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Nell — I’ll check the noticeboard first, then come straight back to you so we’re only passing along the confirmed time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, can you help before school pickup, and do you have work gloves or a ladder we can count on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help before pickup and I’ve got work gloves, but I can’t promise a ladder until I check back home. I’ll confirm quickly while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please come at 8:30 with the gloves, and text me as soon as you know about the ladder.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, I’m glad I found you—the repair drive is shaping up for small fixes like lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes, so if you know anyone who needs help or can lend repair skills, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, Quinn—small fixes, got it. I’ll send folks your way if I remember, and I’m taking my hammer and screwdrivers to Opal for the tool collection today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thank you—I'll spread the word that tools are going to Opal today, and I’ll keep sending repair folks and neighbors with small fixes your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’ve got your spot ready by the labeled boxes—just sort what you can, and a little wave is plenty if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep to the boxes and do what I can quietly; I’ll wave if I get stuck.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli—thank you. I’ll check in from a distance now and then, and you can just point me to anything that seems unsure.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I’ve heard Sam’s aiming for next Saturday at his garage, but I’m still trying to confirm the exact start time so I can work around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s right, Faye—next Saturday at Sam’s garage is the plan. Let’s pencil in 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. unless Sam says otherwise, so folks have a clear window.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli—that 10 to 2 window helps a lot, and I’ll share it as tentative until Sam confirms.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! Right now we’re firming up handy fixers and one organized triage helper for late morning, then I’m hoping to connect a few volunteer circles so the repair drive feels easy and welcoming.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Jules — I’ve got the garage, tool pile, and sign-up sheet underway, so I can also help nudge a few handy folks and ask someone organized to cover triage late morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Sam—thank you. If you can nudge the handy folks and one triage person, I’ll keep matching names across the other groups and make sure everyone hears late morning as the anchor.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Ira—if I’ve got it right, today’s the tool collection for the repair drive, and Opal’s noting what folks drop off. I’m bringing my spare hammer and a couple screwdrivers before I forget.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren—that helps; I’ll let folks know Opal’s tracking the tools today. If you hear any confirmed priority list while you’re there, can you pass it my way?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, Ira, I’ll try to remember—when I drop off the hammer and screwdrivers with Opal, I’ll ask if there’s a confirmed priority list and pass it along to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Faye, I’ve only gotten second-hand updates, but it sounds like the repair drive is this weekend for small fixes—chairs, jackets, lamps, bikes—and Rosa’s tracking logistics while Jules matches handy folks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell — that helps. I’ll check in with Rosa or Jules for the actual start time so I can work around school pickup and send any handy parents their way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds perfect, Faye—if I hear the exact time before you do, I’ll pass it along, and I can help point parents toward Rosa or Jules too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be by the boxes when things start, Dane. Just point me at a pile when you get there, and I’ll sort quietly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli—that’s exactly right. If I’m running late, just stay by the boxes and I’ll set you up with a quiet parts pile as soon as I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright. I’ll wait there and keep out of the way until you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Kira. The repair drive is set for next Saturday at Sam’s garage, and we’re starting with small appliances and tools before matching volunteers to each repair.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Eli—but can you confirm the exact drop-off hours and who’s responsible for storage at Sam’s garage before we pass that around?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good point, Kira—I’ll confirm the drop-off hours with Sam and ask who’s handling storage before we announce anything beyond next Saturday at Sam’s garage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, I’m bringing screwdrivers, pliers, the drill, extra bits, tape, clamps, and a socket set for the repair drive—and I’ll be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’s great, Gus—sounds like you’ve got the tool side covered. I only skimmed the details, but it’s Saturday in the community room, so maybe check in with Jules when you get there early.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Bo—I’ll find Jules when I get there early and see where they want the tools set up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing it together, Quinn, but it sounds like safety repairs come first—roofs, steps, and heating—and I’m trying to quietly note who might need help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That tracks, Rey—I'll spread the word carefully and tell folks safety repairs come first, while also keeping an ear out for lamps, jackets, chairs, and bikes once the smaller fixes list firms up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—that sounds just right. If you hear about any roof leaks, shaky steps, or heating trouble, send those my way first and I’ll keep the smaller fixes separate for now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, I’m still confirming the date, drop-off times, and storage plan before we spread the word. I’ll send you the firm details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—I’ll keep the date, drop-off times, and storage plan marked as pending until you send the confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I’ll check with Kira and circle back once the details are firm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m happy to help, but I’d rather we wait to share the repair drive until Mara confirms the hours, shifts, and rain storage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s sensible, Pia—let’s hold the wider announcement until Mara confirms those details, and I’ll make sure the update says Sunday at the community center so we don’t repeat the old Saturday plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—that helps. Once Mara confirms the hours, volunteer shifts, and rain storage, I’ll feel much better about us putting the word out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, quick update: I heard the repair drive is today, with broken appliances and tools being collected first, and Oren’s bringing a hammer and screwdrivers over to Opal.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh wow, I hadn’t caught that it was today—thanks, Vik. I’ll treat appliances and tools first and Oren bringing tools to Opal as what you’ve heard, but I still want to double-check the time before we spread it too far.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds sensible, Noah—I’ll keep telling folks it’s today with appliances and tools first, but I’ll mention the exact time still needs confirming before anyone heads over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo, can you send me the current confirmed-versus-needed supply list, and do you have any update on Gus’s extra drill bits?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll send you the provisional confirmed-versus-needed list now, Mina; I don’t have a firm update on Gus’s extra drill bits yet, so I’ll keep those marked pending until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. Please keep screws, tape, and spare parts on the needed list, and I’ll check back with Gus about the drill bits.
